# Hilder NPS project instructions

- Preserve the existing dependency-free multi-page HTML, CSS and JavaScript architecture.
- Do not migrate to a framework or add a build step unless the project team explicitly requests it.
- Reuse existing CSS tokens and shared components before creating new patterns.
- Keep navy, ivory, gold and restrained supporting colours consistent through `assets/css/base.css`.
- Do not introduce a competing primary palette, excessive gradients or random inline colours.
- Meet WCAG 2.2 AA: visible keyboard focus, labelled controls, semantic structure, 44px touch targets and meaningful image text.
- Preserve responsive behaviour for 360, 390, 430, 768, 1024, 1280, 1440 and 1920px widths.
- Keep performance high by avoiding dependencies, preserving image dimensions, lazy-loading below-fold media and limiting animation.
- Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Use only verified institutional facts. Do not invent founders, results, statistics, email addresses or campus details.
- Keep SEO metadata unique, valid and compatible with GitHub Pages.
- Preserve form functionality and document third-party or unavailable integrations explicitly.
- Run Playwright tests and inspect real browser output before reporting completion.
- Never discard uncommitted user work or create commits unless explicitly requested.
